name: Steyr Motors AG
summary: Steyr Motors AG engages in manufacturing and selling diesel engines for commercial and military vehicles in Europe, North America, Asia and internationally. It operates through two segments: Civil and Defense. The company offers marine and vehicle diesel engines and accessories; license manufacturing, spare parts, and engineering services, including customizing and complete propulsion / power systems, repowering and value preservation, internal combustion engines, modular service range, and in-house test center for engine and component testing, as well as prototyping, series production, contract manufacturing, and licensing services.
